title: Published film manifest, version 2
description: examples/films.json is the only source for published films: their layer, tier, card copy and the catalogue effects their source runs. tools/films.cjs checks this structure, then the rules it cannot express (one intro, sampler timings, catalogue ids, source evidence, files on disk) and generates every film block from it.

layers.description: Display order of the film layers. Titles and descriptions head the generated film list; singular names build the count sentence.

films.description: Order within a layer is display order.

layer.description: intro: what the repository is. use-case: a familiar video format to adapt. demo: several effects combined into a finished piece. comparison: one input, different treatments. effect-film: a full render of one effect (or a sampler that plays one segment per effect card).

tier.description: hero: the page-top video (only the intro). featured: a large card in its layer's section (use-case or demo). listed: a smaller card in its layer's section (demo or comparison), or, with versionOf, a link on its parent's card; every film is also in the full film list. in-card: plays inside its effect card(s); effect films only.

span.description: [start, end] in authored seconds; 0 <= start < end <= duration.

proof.description: [repository file reachable from the film page, literal text in it] showing where the source runs this effect. Without it, the page itself must name the effect (data-fx, data-demo or the quoted id).

versionOf.description: Another cut, ratio or brand of the named film in the same layer, rendered from the same page; linked from that film's card.

summary.description: One line for the film list, README and viewing guide.

page.description: The editable page that video/build.sh renders.

card.description: Card copy. Featured films need useFor and relation.

guide.description: Repository path of the edit guide.

effects.description: Catalogue ids the film's source actually runs, with optional [start, end]. Ids that only inspired the film belong in related.

groups.description: Build groups for node tools/films.cjs build <group>.

mergeInto.description: Planned: this film's content moves into another film, then this entry is removed.

retire.description: Planned: no new render; the reason.

becomes.description: Planned: the film is rebuilt in another layer.
